records.title: Learning Leadership in Theory and Practice
records.header: LEAD 100 Learning Leadership in Theory and Practice (5) SSc
records.text: LEAD 100 Learning Leadership in Theory and Practice (5) SSc Introduces students to contemporary leadership theories and frameworks. Emphasis on translating formal, academic study of leadership into practice. Highlights authentic leadership constructs and concepts that center the value of social justice and critical perspectives. Develops students' leadership identity and confidence and sets the stage for continued leadership development. Credit/no-credit only. Offered: AWSp.

records.title: Exploring Leadership: Global and Diverse Perspectives
records.header: LEAD 375 Exploring Leadership: Global and Diverse Perspectives (5/6, max. 12) SSc, DIV
records.text: LEAD 375 Exploring Leadership: Global and Diverse Perspectives (5/6, max. 12) SSc, DIV Explores leadership through global and diverse cultural perspectives by examining leadership theories and practices in international or domestic contexts. Through intercultural engagement, dialogue, and critical self-reflections, students develop cross-cultural communication skills and explore how culture shapes leadership processes and relationships. Emphasizes leadership development for an increasingly interconnected and diverse world. Recommended: LEAD 100. Credit/no-credit only. Offered: AS.

records.title: Leadership Certificate
records.text: LEAD 490 Leadership Certificate (2) Guides the creation of a leadership e-portfolio through a series of reflective exercises. Supports students in integrating learning and articulating connections between personal strengths, values, key learning experiences and future goals through a leadership development lens. For Husky Leadership Certificate students. Course overlaps with: LEAD 495. Credit/no-credit only. Offered: W.

records.title: Leadership Practice
records.text: LEAD 499 Leadership Practice (2) Supplements co-curricular and extra-curricular experiences including internships, research, field-based experiences, global engagements, and extra-curricular involvement. Emphasis on development of leadership learning goals, reflection on leadership competency development, and articulation of connections between theory and practice. Recommended: LEAD 100. Credit/no-credit only. Offered: AWSpS.
